card.architecture: MiniMax-H3-Image single-stream DiT (pruned 20B, int8 ConvRot; Qwen3-VL 32B encoder shared with MiniMax-H3 video; 24-channel ViT-decoder VAE; 6-step PDD distilled, no CFG)
card.summary: MiniMax's unified text-to-image and editing model. One checkpoint, two tasks, six sampling steps, no CFG. Native high resolution (4-20 MP working range), strong typography and dense, detailed scenes.
use_cases: dense, detailed scenes from long descriptive prompts
card.commercial_use: restricted (MiniMax H3 Image Community License: separate authorization required above 1M USD annual revenue or for hosted services)
card.pick_when: You want very high native resolution and long-prompt fidelity in a fast 6-step model.

prompt.guidance: Write a long, detailed English description of the WHOLE image: subject, composition, materials, lighting, palette, and any exact quoted text. Short prompts underuse the model.
prompt.example: A cheerful toy-packaging poster: a handmade burnt-sienna plush fox floats above a summer meadow under a clear sky-blue gradient, bright afternoon sun from the upper left. Across the top the word "MINIMAX" in thick felted cream wool letters; along the bottom "TEXT TO IMAGE" in bold cornflower-blue sans-serif.
prompt.instructions: Describe the image as a complete paragraph, front to back: hero subject and pose, surrounding elements, background, materials and textures, lighting direction, colour palette, camera/composition, and every piece of visible text in quotes with its placement and style. The prompt is used as given (up to 4096 tokens). Sampling is fixed by the distillation: 6 steps, CFG 1, Euler/simple.
do: Quote exact visible text and say where it goes
State lighting, palette and materials explicitly
dont: Use tag soup or one-line prompts
Expect a negative prompt to do anything (no CFG)
Change the step count; the checkpoint is distilled to 6 steps
prompt.negative_guidance: Not supported: the model is distilled to CFG 1.

speed.note: Only 6 steps, but a 20B DiT at 4 MP and a 32B text encoder; not yet benchmarked on this box.

ui_help.note: Describe the whole picture in detail. Longer prompts give better results.
ui_help.good_for: high-resolution posters, typography and detailed scenes
